# QuotaPulse — Antigravity代儲・代充值・Gemini / Google AI Ultra Top-Up Hub

> QuotaPulse (`https://vaxaxas.github.io`) is an independent third-party subscription activation & top-up service helping software developers, indie hackers, freelancers, and small engineering teams activate dedicated individual **Google AI Ultra 5x** and **Google AI Ultra 20x** seats directly on their own personal Google account for **Google Antigravity** (`反重力 AI`) and **Gemini Ultra** — without needing an international USD credit card and **NEVER requesting Google passwords, 2FA codes, or exported browser cookies**. QuotaPulse is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Google LLC.
